description: Layer 1 evaluation set for the LLM-powered entry point (recommender/ask.py): a user with a dataset asks, in their own domain language, what they want to find. The original nl_queries.json uses the field's vocabulary ('minimal generators', 'minsup'), so the keyword baseline saturates it; this set is written for the user who does not know that vocabulary. Rules followed while writing it: (1) no query contains a word the rule extractor keys on -- generator, closed, rare, utility, sequen, clickstream, event log, minimal, itemset, minsup -- which nl_domain_eval.py checks mechanically before scoring; (2) roughly half the queries are in Turkish; (3) the set is split into dev and test, the prompt may be tuned only against dev, and test is scored once; (4) three queries per split carry no goal at all -- including the literal question 'which algorithm should I use for this dataset?' -- and are scored separately, because the right behaviour there is to ask, not to guess. data_type is given per query because ask.py measures it from the file rather than asking the model. Caveat that cannot be engineered away: these queries were written by the same agent that wrote the prompt, so the dev/test split and the keyword ban reduce but do not remove author bias. Independently collected queries remain the stronger test.

dev.text: Our clinic records which symptoms each patient reported. For every group of patients who share exactly the same symptom profile, what is the shortest list of symptoms that singles that group out?
Anket verimde her katılımcının işaretlediği seçenekler var. Aynı cevap grubunu ayırt etmek için bakmam gereken en kısa seçenek listesi nedir?
I want compact descriptions: for each distinct set of customers, the smallest combination of purchased products that picks out exactly those customers.
Arıza kayıtlarında hangi hata kodlarının az sayıda bir araya gelmesi aynı makine grubunu tanımlamaya yetiyor? Gereksiz kodları atmak istiyorum.
Which genes can I drop from a signature without changing which samples it matches? I want the leanest version of each signature.
My laptop only has 8 GB of RAM. For each group of transactions, find the smallest number of items needed to identify it.
Veri büyük ve sonucu hızlı almam lazım: her kayıt grubunu ayırt eden en kısa ürün kombinasyonları.
Which bundles of products always show up together, as large as they can get without losing any of the baskets they occur in?
Birlikte görülen en geniş özellik gruplarını istiyorum; gruba bir özellik daha eklersem kapsadığı kayıt sayısı düşmeli.
List the largest co-occurring item groups for each frequency level -- the complete versions, not the shortened ones.
I need a lossless summary of all frequent item combinations, keeping the biggest representative of each.
Her sıklık seviyesinde, üzerine hiçbir şey eklenemeyecek kadar tamamlanmış ürün setleri.
I want rules of the form 'if a customer buys A and B, they always also buy C', with 100% confidence and no redundant rules.
Kesin kurallar arıyorum: 'X varsa Y de her zaman var' türünden, fazlalıksız bir kural tabanı.
Produce a non-redundant basis of exact implications between attributes, with the shortest left-hand sides.
For each group of records, I need both the shortest identifying condition and the full set of attributes it implies.
Hangi belirti kombinasyonu, hangi ek belirtileri kesin olarak beraberinde getiriyor? Sol taraf mümkün olduğunca kısa olsun.
Fraud team here: we care about combinations of transaction flags that almost never occur together.
Nadiren birlikte görülen, olağandışı özellik kombinasyonlarını bulmak istiyorum.
Find the smallest combinations of alerts that are unusual, appearing in only a tiny fraction of the records.
Which pairings of prescriptions almost never happen? They could signal a dispensing error.
Our receipts include the price of each item. Which small combinations of products bring in the most revenue?
Satış verimde kâr bilgisi de var. En kârlı, en az ürünlü kombinasyonlar hangileri?
Find compact item sets whose total profit exceeds 500, without redundant items.
Which small product bundles are worth the most money?
Users click through pages in order. What are the shortest page paths that characterise groups of sessions?
Hastaların tedavi adımları sırasıyla kayıtlı. Aynı hasta grubunu ayırt eden en kısa adım dizileri neler?
In our app logs order matters; give me the leanest event chains that identify recurring behaviour.
Which ordered chains of purchases are the shortest ones that still describe the same customer journeys?
Find interesting patterns in my data.
Bu veride ne var, bana örüntüleri göster.
What algorithm should I use for this dataset?

test.text: Each row is a student and the courses they passed. For every cohort of students with identical records, what is the shortest list of courses that tells that cohort apart?
Müşteri segmentlerini tanımlamak istiyorum ama her segment için sadece gerçekten gerekli olan ürünleri söyleyerek; fazlalık istemiyorum.
Which attributes are redundant? For each group of records I want the leanest attribute combination that still matches exactly that group.
Hangi sensör alarmlarının en küçük bileşimi aynı arıza grubunu işaret ediyor?
Give me the most concise conditions that single out each group of insurance claims.
Memory is tight on our server. For each set of matching orders, the tiniest product combination that identifies it.
Çok hızlı sonuç lazım: her müşteri grubunu tanımlayan en kısa ürün listesi.
What are the fullest groups of features that occur together, where adding anything else would shrink the set of rows they cover?
Birlikte geçen en büyük ürün gruplarını istiyorum; her birine bir ürün daha eklenirse kapsam daralmalı.
Summarise the frequent combinations losslessly by keeping only the most complete version of each.
I want the saturated co-occurrence sets -- nothing can be added to them without dropping records.
Kayıpsız bir özet: her sıklık grubunun en eksiksiz temsilcisi.
Show me dependencies like 'whenever these two options are chosen, this third one is always chosen too', without redundancy.
'A ve B alınıyorsa C de mutlaka alınıyor' gibi kesin bağıntılar istiyorum, tekrarsız.
Derive a compact set of certain rules between attributes, left sides as short as possible.
For every record group give me the briefest defining condition together with everything that condition guarantees.
Hangi kısa koşul, hangi özelliklerin kesinlikle bulunacağını garanti ediyor?
Security wants the combinations of log flags that are extremely uncommon together.
Çok nadir rastlanan ilaç kombinasyonlarını tespit etmek istiyorum.
Which pairs of settings are almost never used together? Those might be misconfigurations.
Find unusual co-occurrences that show up in only a handful of records.
Each sale line has its margin. Which short combinations of items generate the highest profit?
Hangi az ürünlü kombinasyonlar en çok ciro getiriyor? Fiyatlar veride var.
Find the leanest product sets whose combined value is above a given amount.
Which compact baskets are the most lucrative?
The order of steps in each workflow matters. What are the shortest chains of steps that characterise each type of workflow?
Kullanıcıların sayfa gezinme sırası kayıtlı; aynı davranış grubunu tanımlayan en kısa sayfa dizileri nedir?
Give me the most concise ordered event chains that describe recurring customer journeys.
Which ordered series of treatments are the briefest ones that still identify each patient pathway?
Analyse this dataset for me.
Bu veri için hangi algoritmayı kullanmalıyım?
Mine my data.
